name: OpenLane-V2 — 3D Lane and Traffic Topology Dataset
description: Pioneering road topology and scene structure dataset for autonomous driving, developed by OpenDriveLab and Shanghai AI Laboratory. Expands autonomous perception beyond bounding boxes to comprehensive 3D lane centerline modeling and topological relationship reasoning between traffic lanes and traffic regulatory elements (traffic lights, road signs). Built upon 2,000 multi-view driving sequences containing 88,000 annotated frames, supporting lane detection, scene parsing, and navigation planning.
